purpose: Translate completed independent holdouts and pre-outcome feasibility work into clear system roles without changing the frozen 100-point RK-MIS score.

DISCOVERY_PRIMARY.reason: The completed standalone objective/technical holdouts did not establish reliable multibagger discovery alpha. The documentary pipeline remains blinded to future outcomes and is specifically designed to reconstruct forward-looking business evidence known at the anchor date.

QUALITY_RISK_FILTER.reason: The 2023 fundamental growth-quality holdout modestly reduced top-quartile losses but produced lower mean return, lower 2x/5x rates and a neutral-to-negative rank signal.

CONFIRMATION_TIMING.reason: The 2022 technical holdout improved 5x concentration and mean multiple in the top quartile but materially worsened loss rate and had negative rank correlation.

SMART_MONEY_CONTEXT.reason: The 2023 promoter-accumulation holdout showed lower mean return, lower 2x/5x rates, higher loss rate and negative rank correlation. Promoter change therefore cannot proxy the full smart-money pillar.

decision_framework.candidate_creation: Prefer chronology-safe runway/moat/catalyst evidence once the strict documentary cohort becomes feasible.
decision_framework.candidate_rejection: Use governance, weak cash/quality, excessive leverage and evidence gaps as fail-closed or risk-reducing context where applicable.
decision_framework.entry_confirmation: Use technical accumulation only after the business thesis qualifies; do not let technical strength manufacture a thesis.
decision_framework.smart_money_confirmation: Require multiple independent smart-money components rather than promoter holding change alone.
decision_framework.missing_evidence: Never convert missing historical evidence to zero and never lower review rules to increase sample size.
decision_framework.weight_changes: No pillar weight or band may change from one holdout; a separate preregistered admission decision is required.

pending_experiments.purpose: Test whether growth/quality interaction plus optional promoter change performs differently from the already-completed standalone component tests.
Determine whether the expanded 383-document blinded evidence pool produces at least the frozen minimum cohort under strict two-family relation/review rules before loading future outcomes.
